title: On Generalized Barron Spaces for Shallow Neural Networks
summary: Classical Barron spaces are function spaces specifically designed for shallow neural networks mostly with ReLU, $\mathrm{ReLU}^k$ (RePU) or Lipschitz continuous activation functions. In the present work, we introduce a generalized Barron space \( B_σ^{\varphi} \) for shallow neural networks with a generic activation function possessing certain smoothness properties.
